release_state: Registry release selection, 2026-09-30: the user selects `qleisli` for both the first crates.io package and Rust import name, with a documented [migration/alias](crates-io-release.md#name-migration-from-github-releases-through-020) from earlier Git/path releases. This narrow identity exception retains version 0.2.1; the subsequent user request authorizes rechecking and cargo publish outside the sandbox; actual upload success is recorded separately in the release record. Latest scope revision, 2026-09-30: [0.2.1](v0.2.1-plan.md) retains completed corpus/source experiments, review fixes, component proofs and [bounded Python/OpenQASM/QIR connections](connections-v021.md); heavy measured shared-QPE implementation, production integration and proofs move to [0.2.2](v0.2.2-plan.md), with their unmet gates and the original corpus goal deferred rather than completed; Rust remains authoritative and external schemas stay disabled; manifests remain 0.2.1, unreleased. The 2026-09-30 [Resource Safety Theorem](release-milestones.md#resource-safety-theorem-v1) is adopted as the third v1 pillar alongside Soundness and Physical Realizability, explicitly to prove under RS-C1–C5; [resource semantics](resource-semantics.md) targets finite static bounds preserved by compilation, without changing current authority or 0.2.1/0.2.2 gates. Historical development account: 0.2.1 development selected by the user on 2026-09-29; unreleased; [development record](releases/v0.2.1.md); 0.2.0 release scope finalized on 2026-09-29: [finite interfaces and experimental Lean foundation](v0.2.0-plan.md) retained; migration and release validation recorded separately; remaining shared-QPE work and unchanged feature gates moved to the compatible [0.2.1 target](v0.2.1-plan.md), or 0.3.0 if a public break is necessary; CBits spelling retained; [structural type contract and tuple migration](type-system.md) implemented with distinct n-ary/nested types; Rust is the default for unresolved type/ownership design; finite X2–X6 implemented and tested; [Lean migration](lean-kernel-migration.md) adopted with proved experimental phase-word and [shared-DAG](lean-hierarchy-slice.md) executables plus [typed layout](lean-layout-slice.md) permutation/reference proofs and [shared typed call](lean-layout-dag-slice.md) graph soundness, now joined by [sparse phase/layout](lean-phase-layout-slice.md) composition proofs and [interference/complex interpretation](lean-interference-slice.md) and [actual QFT circuit/Fourier proofs](lean-qft-proof-packet.md), extended to an [accepted typed graph projection](lean-qft-graph-packet.md), plus [QPE residual-instrument, coherent controlled-power and conditional completeness proofs](lean-qpe-instrument-packet.md); [Qleisli Soundness Theorem / S05-C1–C5](release-milestones.md#qleisli-soundness-theorem-v050) targeted for v0.5.0 with community expansion thereafter, not yet achieved; [Physical Realizability Theorem / PR-C1–C4](release-milestones.md#physical-realizability-theorem-v1) and a proved Lean backend adopted as v1 requirements, not yet implemented or proved; [sequential pipeline migration](lean-kernel-migration.md#pipeline-migration-with-a-stable-ir-verification-boundary) adopted on 2026-09-29: move passes from either end while retaining independent boundary-IR checking and extending verified downstream coverage only through actual-pass preservation proofs or independent translation validation; the fixed trust partition and explicit transitional/native assumptions remain unchanged; [de Bruijn checking per pass](lean-kernel-migration.md#external-search-and-the-leafrealizer-checker) keeps candidate/proof search external, including rotation-synthesis norm-equation search, behind the planned proved Lean LeafRealizer checker; no blanket migration of all Rust or search code, and no implemented LeafRealizer API claimed; [required Lean backend and execution policy](lean-kernel-migration.md#backend-execution-must-match-kernel-definitions) reaffirmed: source and compiled-declaration CI forbid project unsafe/partial definitions and implemented_by/extern replacement, including private/generated helpers, alongside axiom audits; existing four-construct bans now have dedicated backend regression coverage; production acceptance remains Rust; component schema types/source are pinned; typed artifact preparation derives dependencies, binds exact proof endpoints and shares its budget with the proved acyclic scheduler and actual whole-definition and meaning/encoding typing checks; explicit Bits/Bit, tuple and empty-owner conversions now have checked actual inverse routing and reference coefficient round trips; controlled powers now project actual implementation/meaning bodies and retain explicit provider-proof obligations with operator/reference theorems; a supported whole-space derivation pass now checks actual rules and provider premises from an empty cache, with proved finite closure and constructed equal, unique complex operator/reference denotations for supported accepted rules, without an assumed interpretation environment; whole-space unitarity and arbitrary finite reference extension now follow recursively from supported internal checker success; full-profile semantics, hierarchy/schema integration, sized source, reference execution and H1–H5 remain pending in the 0.2.1 continuation; all external schema entries remain disabled; [QLT design and TQL-0 source records](qlt-design.md) retained with its Rust experiment deferred by the user on 2026-09-29 to v0.4.0 or later, after the planned [v0.3.0 Qleisli type-system specification at the breaking-change boundary](v0x-roadmap.md#v030-qleisli-type-system-specification); QPE/CBits and production integration remain open; [coherent QPE source](../corpus/sized/qualtran_qpe/README.md) now passes small selected sizes with transparent operation providers, actual controlled repeats and independent full-state/reference diagnostics;
